verdict.rationale: A company registry's sign-in method is a fair axis for this kind of product, so it applies. The pack contains no evidence about MCA's published sign-in path: the only probes are HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Those responses say nothing about whether login uses remotely completable credential MFA or biometric, in-person or mailed-PIN steps.
